sql: SELECT timestamp, _sample_interval AS weight, index1 AS agent, blob1 AS event, blob2 AS product, blob3 AS mode, blob4 AS phase, blob5 AS outcome, blob6 AS error, blob7 AS broker_code, double1 AS ts, double2 AS latency_ms, double3 AS daily_pnl, double4 AS equity, double5 AS position, double6 AS other_exposure, double7 AS execution, double9 AS has_pnl, double10 AS has_equity FROM dodash_paper_trading WHERE index1 = 'btc-usd-paper' AND double1 >= 1789862400000 AND double1 < 1790412671696 ORDER BY ts ASC LIMIT 10000
